Allow to visualise agendas and select dates.
See [Date & Time picker guidelines<i class="mat-icon">launch</i>](https://design-system.airbus.corp/components/date-time-picker/design/)

It is used by the <LinkTo kind="Components/DatePicker" story="docs">Date Picker</LinkTo> component.
